_comment: RAW-STEP CORROBORATION smoke — 305 sta, GPS+Galileo, 30 s, 10 epochs, COLD.
QUESTION.  The golden 3 h run emitted 1,330,066 D5 flag rows whose `raw_stepped`
column was EMPTY in every single one, so we could not tell whether D5 is resetting
arcs that actually stepped in the raw observables, or arcs the raw data says are
perfectly continuous.  With median std_innov ~= 90 against a k*sigma0_hat gate of
~11.6, and 1,636 arcs stuck in continuous reset for 200+ epochs, that fork decides
everything: a real satellite-level event vs. a model error being mistaken for slips.
ROOT CAUSE — an ARMING gap, not a code gap.  The writer already exists and is
correct (NetworkInstallCarry.cpp:537-562, deliberately TRI-STATE 1/0/blank).  It
goes blank when `slip_qc.epoch.computed` is false, and that whole raw-observable
path is skipped unless a consumer asks:
SlipQcParams::anyConsumer = trace_slip_raw || lli_corroborate || gap_instrument
The golden armed NONE of the three, so `armed()` was false and nothing was ever
computed.  Populating the column needs `cardsArmed()` too
(= lli_corroborate || gap_instrument), because `stepped` / `verdict[].measured` are
filled by networkQualifyRawObservables, which is gated on it
(ApplicationNetworkAssembly.cpp:1281).
⚠ NOTE a doc/code mismatch found while confirming this: the SlipQcParams banner
(NetworkRawObservables.hpp:199-202) claims the qualification pass 'still runs ...
only when a consumer asked for it' with both cards off.  The CODE gates it on
cardsArmed().  The code is authoritative; the header comment is wrong.
WHY gap_instrument AND NOT mw_lli_corroborate.  Card G is documented
instrumentation-only — 'Counters + trace rows only' (GnssConfigTypes.hpp:391) — and
the step verdicts it unlocks (`v.measured`, `ep.stepped`) are computed
UNCONDITIONALLY inside the qualification pass; only the arc-resumption counters are
gated on the knob itself.  Card L (mw_lli_corroborate) is a DECISION card: it
suppresses LLI assertions and demotes chattering stations, which would perturb the
very behaviour we are trying to observe.  The promotion ledger also records both of
Card L's own falsifiers as VOID / NOT MET.  So Card G buys the evidence at zero
decision cost; Card L would buy it by changing the experiment.
trace_slip_raw is armed as the independent cross-check: network_slip_raw.csv carries
the per-(station,satellite) MW / GF / LLI the verdicts are derived from, so the
`raw_stepped` tag can be audited rather than trusted.
EXPECTED READ.  If most D5 flags come back raw_stepped=0, D5 is resetting
continuous arcs and the 80-sigma innovations are model error, not slips — which
makes the reset loop a mis-attribution and points at a whole-satellite response
(the IF-TD card's 'whole-sat not per-arc' principle).  If they come back 1, these
are real events and the satellite concentration (G14/G15/G24, Block IIR/IIR-M) is
the lead instead.  The prior from the IF-phase side is 97% NO raw step.
Everything else is the golden verbatim, so the flags themselves are comparable.
